benchmark_script:
# Credit: Taylor (gtmcknight), amm-sim@4812a6382311624e1506aca131ca35c378f930d9 research/solved.
import sys, time, hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path('bootstrap').resolve()))
from smoke_engine import config_for, check_transcription
import amm_sim_rs
from amm_competition.evm.compiler import SolidityCompiler
from amm_competition.evm.baseline import get_vanilla_bytecode_and_abi
p=Path('scratch/reference/qt1/Strategy.sol'); raw=p.read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()=='c68887cff61180e12ba2b1ceb333edf76a830f91f63b5d775a8806fb9ec08aca'
t=time.perf_counter(); r=SolidityCompiler().compile(raw.decode()); assert r.success,r.errors
v=get_vanilla_bytecode_and_abi()[0]; compile_s=time.perf_counter()-t
checked=check_transcription(); amm_sim_rs.gas_stats_reset(); t=time.perf_counter()
b=amm_sim_rs.run_batch(list(r.bytecode),list(v),[config_for(9700000)],8)
d={'compile_seconds':compile_s,'run_seconds':time.perf_counter()-t,'fields_checked':checked,'rows':[{'seed':x.seed,'edge':x.edges['submission']} for x in b.results],'stats':amm_sim_rs.gas_stats()}
Path('scratch/benchmark.json').write_text(json.dumps(d,indent=2)); print(json.dumps(d))

# Credit: Taylor (gtmcknight), amm-sim@4812a6382311624e1506aca131ca35c378f930d9 research/solved.
import sys, json, time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path('.').resolve()))
import engine_eval as e
source=Path('scratch/engine/amm-challenge/contracts/src/VanillaStrategy.sol').read_text().replace('contract VanillaStrategy','contract Strategy')
p=Path('scratch/candidate.sol'); p.write_text(source)
t=time.perf_counter(); rows=e.run_batch([9700511],p)
assert len(rows)==1 and rows[0]['seed']==9700511
result=dict(_credit=e.CREDIT, candidate_source_sha256=e.digest(p), rows=rows, seconds=time.perf_counter()-t, config_fields_compared=e.config_equivalence())
e.atomic_json('scratch/integration.json',result)
print(json.dumps(result))
unit_test_command: timeout 60 python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_engine_eval.py
notes: Raw benchmark edge matches bank seed 9700000 exactly.

Linux x86_64 only; macOS arm64 engine unsupported; other platforms untested.
timing_note: First generator did not emit command wall time; its summed singleton duration is recorded. Parallel singleton durations overlap and must not be interpreted as CPU time or total wall time.
